title: Actual-ring finite coefficient transport and normalized local restriction
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with an algebra embedding $i:E\to F$, and their actual valuation rings $A,B$ and uniformizers from [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For schemes $T$ in universe $u$ take $E,F$ in universe $u+1$, with the actual-ring adic data and completed coefficient sheaves $R_T,S_T$ of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete] and [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Use the integer inclusion and quotient inclusions of [def-weil-pbc-integer-quotient-inclusions]. In the adic-ideal-power presentations, define $q_n:A/I_A^{n+1}\to B/I_B^{n+1}$ by the quotient lift of that same integer inclusion. Define $c_T:R_T\to S_T$ to be the unique map with $c_T;\pi_{B,n}=\pi_{A,n};(q_n)_T$ for every $n\geq0$, using the coefficient sheaf maps of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Its naturality for $g:X\to Y$ is $c_Y;a_B=a_A;g_*c_X$, where $a_A,a_B$ are the canonical completed structure maps. Define the ambient scalar functor to be the existing derived change of rings along $c_T$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Define its scalar/restriction comparison to be [def-weil-pbc-normalized-scalar-restriction] specialized to this natural square, retaining both its ordinary adjunction normalization and its cochain K-flat normalization. All coefficient rings, quotient indices and structure maps are the specified ones; no arbitrary ring map or natural isomorphism is selected.
